### How Do We Do as Paul Says and 'Be Joyful in Hope'?
Author: Whitney Hopler
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/faith/spiritual-life/how-do-we-do-as-paul-says-and-be-joyful-in-hope.html
Passage: Romans 12:12
Points:
- Joyful hope rests on God's trustworthy character rather than fluctuating life circumstances.
- Hope, patience in trials, and prayer work together to direct our focus to God's purposes.
- Believers can nurture hope by rejecting worst-case worries and anticipating God's goodness.
- Consistent communication through prayer connects believers directly to the source of true joy.
- Approaching daily life with hopeful curiosity allows believers to see God's ongoing work as an adventure.

### A Different Kind of Church
Author: Holly Good
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-jan-16-2012.html
Passage: Romans 12:10
Points:
- True brotherly love means stepping beyond ordinary church routines to meet real needs.
- Honoring others above ourselves involves paying attention to people who are overlooked.
- Acting in obedience to help struggling neighbors replaces personal anxiety with God's peace.
- Demonstrating faith through tangible service models Christ's love to children and others.
